                        - generic [ref=e687]: "25: figurana Kuznerzoy, 1997 (colour plate 8: 39)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e688]: "Eucosmomorpha figurana Kuznetzov, 1997, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 76 (4): 804, fig. 9."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e689]: "Types: Holotype ¢, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai-Kontum, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 28.X1.1988, V. KuzNErzov leg."
                        - generic [ref=e690]: "Comments: The 8 is still unknown. In the original description fig. 9 was erroneously named as Eucosmomorpha segregana sp. N.,"
                        - generic [ref=e691]: holotype, South Vietnam, Tramlap. Actually, this figure belongs to the holotype of E. figurana Kuzn.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e692]: "Taxonomic notes: In Brown et al. (2005) the original combination was given erroneously as Enarmonia figurana Kuzn. Distribu-"
                        - generic [ref=e693]: "tion: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e694]: "26. finitimana Kuznetzov, 1997 (colour plate 8: 37)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e695]: "Phaecasiophora finitimana KuzNEtzov, 1997, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 76 (4): 799, fig. 5."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e696]: "Types: Holotype , S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai-Kontum, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 30.21.1988, V. KuzNETzov leg."
                        - generic [ref=e697]: "Comments: The ? is unknown. Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e698]: "27. flavescens KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate 8: 31)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e699]: "Tetramoera flavescens KUZNETzov, 1988, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 67 (3): 619, fig. 7."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e700]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Sonla, Chiengchouan, 13.V.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 1c’, 4 99, the same province,"
                        - generic [ref=e701]: Naniu, 4.-12.V.1986, Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e702]: "Comments: The 2 of this species is described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988a: 620, fig. 8). Although KuzNetzov mentioned"
                        - generic [ref=e703]: "499 as paratypes, only 3 of them were found in the collection of ZISP. Distribution: North Vietnam: Ban Chiéng Khoang, Naniu."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e704]: "28. fulturana Kuznetzov, 1992 (colour plate 8: 42)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e705]: "Fulcrifera fulturana Kuznetzov, 1992, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 71 (4): 854, fig. 10."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e706]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Sonla, Chiengchouan, 13.V.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e707]: "Present status: Thaumatotibia fulturana (Kuznetzov, 1992). Comments: The ? is unknown."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e708]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Fulcrifera but KuzNetzov (1997) transferred it to Metriophlebia. Later"
                        - generic [ref=e709]: "Metriophlebia was synonymized with Thaumatotibia (e.g. BRown et al., 2005). Distribution: Vietnam: Ban Chiéng Khoang, Kan-"
                        - generic [ref=e710]: nack (KUZNETZzov, 2003).
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e711]: "29. fumidana Kuznetzov, 1997 (colour plate 8: 32)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e712]: "Dicnecidia fumidana Kuznerzov, 1997, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie. 76 (4): 807, fig. 15."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e713]: "Types: Holotype ¢, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai-Kontum, Kannak, 600 m, 11.21.1988, V. KuzNEtzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e714]: "Comments: In the original description Kuznetzov noted that the holotype has no cornuti in aedeagus (p. 808). During our study"
                        - generic [ref=e715]: we collected a series of specimens at the Mê Linh biological station (North Vietnam, Vinh Phuc Prov., Ngoc Thanh vill.) which
                        - generic [ref=e716]: "completely corresponded to the description and the figure by KuzNetzov (1997: Plate 2, fig. 12a), except for a strong bundle formed"
                        - generic [ref=e717]: by long and slender cornuti in the vesica. Their length is approximately as the length of the aedeagus (Plate 2, fig. 12b). Therefore
                        - generic [ref=e718]: the cornuti in the genitalia of the holotype were probably lost during preparation of the genitalia.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e719]: The original description was based on a single & specimen; the 2 is unknown. In the series of specimens from Mé Linh several 9°
                        - generic [ref=e720]: clearly correspond to the oo of D. fumidana Kuzn. They are therefore considered as 9 of this species. The description of the °
                        - generic [ref=e721]: "genitalia is given below in the taxonomic appendix. Distribution: North Vietnam, Kannack, Mé Linh biol. station."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e722]: "30. ghilarovi KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate’: 34)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e723]: "Sorolopha ghilarovi KuzNetTzoy, 1988, Trudy vsesoyuznogo entomologicheskogo obshchestva 70: 178, fig. 9: 1."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e724]: "Types: Holotype 7, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 13.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 11 gg, 11 99, the same locality,"
                        - generic [ref=e725]: 10.-13.1V.1986, 5 cc, 19, N. Vietnam, Hanoi, 3.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e726]: "Comments: The 2 of this species was described in the same paper by KuzNetzov (1988b: 180, fig. 9: 2). Although KuzNetzov noted"
                        - generic [ref=e727]: 11 cv, 11 9¢ from Tam Dao as paratypes, 16 c?, 13 99 with Kuznetzov’s handwritten red label “Paratype Sorolopha ghilarovi KuzN”
                        - generic [ref=e728]: were found in the collection of ZISP. All of them were collected in Tam Dao 10.-13.IV.1986. Besides that, only 4 paratype To from
                        - generic [ref=e729]: Hanoi were found in the collection. One other « and one ? from Hanoi mentioned as paratypes in the original description were
                        - generic [ref=e730]: "probably lost. Distribution: Vietnam, Fan-Si-Pan, Mai-Chau, Mt. NgocLinh (RazowskI, 2008), Hanoi, Tam Dao."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e731]: "31. inauditana KUZNETZzOV, 1988 (colour plate 8: 33)"
                      - paragraph:

messages.content:
You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."
                        - generic [ref=e619]: (2005) who treated Griselda nielseni KAwaBE as a good species insertae sedis. Comparison of the original description of G nielseni
                        - generic [ref=e620]: Kawase and the holotype of G blanditana Kuzn. confirms that Griselda nielseni Kawase should be considered as a junior synonym
                        - generic [ref=e621]: of G blanditana Kuzn. Brown et al. (2005) placed G blanditana Kuzn. in the group “Eucosmini unplaced species” with a reference
                        - generic [ref=e622]: “Although described in Griselda (now considered a synonym of Epinotia), blanditana Kuzn. does not belong in Epinotia because it
                        - generic [ref=e623]: "lacks the cleft or divided uncus typical of the genus (R. BRown)” (BRown et al., 2005: 740). However, in 2000, KuzNnetzov transfer-"
                        - generic [ref=e624]: red blanditana to Rhopobota and this combination is accepted here.

                      - paragraph:

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e616]: "Present status: Rhopobota blanditana (KUZNETZzOV, 1988)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e617]: "Comments: The ? of this species is still unknown."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."
                        - generic [ref=e619]: (2005) who treated Griselda nielseni KAwaBE as a good species insertae sedis. Comparison of the original description of G nielseni
                        - generic [ref=e620]: Kawase and the holotype of G blanditana Kuzn. confirms that Griselda nielseni Kawase should be considered as a junior synonym
                        - generic [ref=e621]: of G blanditana Kuzn. Brown et al. (2005) placed G blanditana Kuzn. in the group “Eucosmini unplaced species” with a reference
                        - generic [ref=e622]: “Although described in Griselda (now considered a synonym of Epinotia), blanditana Kuzn. does not belong in Epinotia because it
                        - generic [ref=e623]: "lacks the cleft or divided uncus typical of the genus (R. BRown)” (BRown et al., 2005: 740). However, in 2000, KuzNnetzov transfer-"
                        - generic [ref=e624]: red blanditana to Rhopobota and this combination is accepted here.

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e630]: "Comments: The F of this species was described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988c: 96, fig. 36). Although Kuznetzov designa-"
                        - generic [ref=e631]: ted 10 9¢ from Tam Dao as paratypes, only 6 of them were found in the collection of ZISP. Besides that, 2 gg, 2 99 were mentioned
                        - generic [ref=e632]: by Kuznetzov from Hanoi but actually 3 cc’, 1 2 of them are present in the collection.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e633]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Grapholita but in 1992 it was transferred without any discussion to the"
                        - generic [ref=e634]: genus Cydia by RAzowsx1. However, his opinion was ignored by later revisers (e.g. KUZzNETZov, 2000; BRowN et al., 2005). In this
                        - generic [ref=e635]: "work I follow the opinion by Kuznetzov and treat the species in Grapholita. Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Hanoi."

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e639]: "Comments: The 2 is still unknown. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KUZNETZov’s"
                        - generic [ref=e640]: material was one specimen collected 26.X1.1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten white label “He ab-
                        - generic [ref=e641]: "rupta u He hapalanta” [not abrupta and not hapalanta). On the other side of this label KUZNETZov wrote: “Semniotes hapalantoides"
                        - generic [ref=e642]: Kuzn. sp. n., holotype”. Probably “hapalanta” is the incorrect name of Semniotes halantha Meyrick, 1909. At the same time, in the
                        - generic [ref=e643]: original description KuzNETzov mentioned that the narrow valva of S. confinana Kuzn. differs from those of S. halantha MEYRICK,
                        - generic [ref=e644]: "1909 and_S. abrupta DiaKonorr, 1973 (KUZNETZOV, 2003: 729). The genitalia of the single specimen completely correspond with the"
                        - generic [ref=e645]: original description of S. confinana Kuzn. Thus, in spite of the specimen was marked by Kuznetzov as hapalantoides, it was consi-
                        - generic [ref=e646]: "dered to be a holotype of confinana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS, Semniotes confinana KUZNETZOV,"

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

                        - generic [ref=e605]: "from the collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KuzNetzov’s material 2 specimens were found: One of them bears KUZNETZov’s"

                        - generic [ref=e607]: "dala biuncana sp. n.”. The second specimen was considered as a paratype and marked with a red printed label by me: “PARATYPUS,"
                        - generic [ref=e608]: Peridaedala biuncana Kuznetzov, 1997”.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e609]: "Distribution: Vietnam, Tram Lap; Thailand; Indonesia (KUZNETZzov, 2000)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e610]: "18. blanditana Kuznetzov, 1988 (colour plate 7: 11)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e611]: "Griselda blanditana Kuznetzov, 1988, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 67 (3): 622, fig. 12."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e612]: "Griselda nielseni Kawase, 1989, Microlepidoptera of Thailand 2: 58, figs 90, 118. Locus typicus: Thailand, Chieng Mai Prov., Huai"
                        - generic [ref=e613]: Nam Dang.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e614]: "Types: Holotype, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 11.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratype: 1’, the same locality, 13.IV.1986,"
                        - generic [ref=e615]: V. Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e616]: "Present status: Rhopobota blanditana (KUZNETZzOV, 1988)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e617]: "Comments: The ? of this species is still unknown."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."
                        - generic [ref=e619]: (2005) who treated Griselda nielseni KAwaBE as a good species insertae sedis. Comparison of the original description of G nielseni
                        - generic [ref=e620]: Kawase and the holotype of G blanditana Kuzn. confirms that Griselda nielseni Kawase should be considered as a junior synonym
                        - generic [ref=e621]: of G blanditana Kuzn. Brown et al. (2005) placed G blanditana Kuzn. in the group “Eucosmini unplaced species” with a reference
                        - generic [ref=e622]: “Although described in Griselda (now considered a synonym of Epinotia), blanditana Kuzn. does not belong in Epinotia because it
                        - generic [ref=e623]: "lacks the cleft or divided uncus typical of the genus (R. BRown)” (BRown et al., 2005: 740). However, in 2000, KuzNnetzov transfer-"
                        - generic [ref=e624]: red blanditana to Rhopobota and this combination is accepted here.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e625]: "Distribution: Vietnam: Tam Dao; Thailand (KuzNetzov, 2000)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e626]: "19. comanticosta KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate 7: 16)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e627]: "Grapholita comanticosta KuzNEtTzov, 1988, Trudy zoologicheskogo Instituta, Leningrad, 176: 94, fig. 35."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e628]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 14.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 3 c7, 10 99, the same locality,"
                        - generic [ref=e629]: "9.-11.IV.1986, V. KuzNnetzov leg.; 2 #c*, 299, N. Vietnam, Hanoi, 2.-3.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e630]: "Comments: The F of this species was described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988c: 96, fig. 36). Although Kuznetzov designa-"
                        - generic [ref=e631]: ted 10 9¢ from Tam Dao as paratypes, only 6 of them were found in the collection of ZISP. Besides that, 2 gg, 2 99 were mentioned
                        - generic [ref=e632]: by Kuznetzov from Hanoi but actually 3 cc’, 1 2 of them are present in the collection.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e633]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Grapholita but in 1992 it was transferred without any discussion to the"
                        - generic [ref=e634]: genus Cydia by RAzowsx1. However, his opinion was ignored by later revisers (e.g. KUZzNETZov, 2000; BRowN et al., 2005). In this
                        - generic [ref=e635]: "work I follow the opinion by Kuznetzov and treat the species in Grapholita. Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Hanoi."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e636]: "20. confinana KuzneEtzov, 2003 (colour plate 7: 12)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e637]: "Semniotes confinana Kuznetzov, 2003, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 82 (3): 727, fig. 11."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e638]: "Types: Holotype g, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 26.X1.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e639]: "Comments: The 2 is still unknown. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KUZNETZov’s"
                        - generic [ref=e640]: material was one specimen collected 26.X1.1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten white label “He ab-
                        - generic [ref=e641]: "rupta u He hapalanta” [not abrupta and not hapalanta). On the other side of this label KUZNETZov wrote: “Semniotes hapalantoides"
                        - generic [ref=e642]: Kuzn. sp. n., holotype”. Probably “hapalanta” is the incorrect name of Semniotes halantha Meyrick, 1909. At the same time, in the
                        - generic [ref=e643]: original description KuzNETzov mentioned that the narrow valva of S. confinana Kuzn. differs from those of S. halantha MEYRICK,
                        - generic [ref=e644]: "1909 and_S. abrupta DiaKonorr, 1973 (KUZNETZOV, 2003: 729). The genitalia of the single specimen completely correspond with the"
                        - generic [ref=e645]: original description of S. confinana Kuzn. Thus, in spite of the specimen was marked by Kuznetzov as hapalantoides, it was consi-
                        - generic [ref=e646]: "dered to be a holotype of confinana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS, Semniotes confinana KUZNETZOV,"
                        - generic [ref=e647]: 2003”. The holotype has no hindwings and one of the forewings was glued to the thorax.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e648]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e649]: "21, dentiuncana KUzNEtzov, 2003 (colour plate 7: 2)"

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e651]: "Types: Holotype g, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 1.XII.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e652]: "Comments: The 2 is not described. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP. However, in the drawer with"
                        - generic [ref=e653]: Kuznetzov’s working material was one specimen collected 1.XII. 1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten
                        - generic [ref=e654]: white label “Drachmobola sp. n.”. The genitalia of this specimen completely correspond with those figured in the original description
                        - generic [ref=e655]: "of dentiuncana. So it was considered to be a holotype of dentiuncana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS,"
                        - generic [ref=e656]: Drachmobola dentiuncana Kuznetzoy, 2003”. The holotype has no hindwings and one of the forewings was glued to the thorax.
                        - generic [ref=e657]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e658]: "22. diakonoffi KuzNetzov, 1988 (colour plate 7: 15)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e659]: "Statherotis diakonoffi KuzNETzov, 1988, Trudy vsesoyuznogo entomologicheskogo obshchestva 70: 168, fig. 3: 3."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e660]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 9.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratype: 1c, the same locality, 11.IV.1986,"
                        - generic [ref=e661]: V. Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e662]: "Comments: In the collection of ZISP there are also 2 9° specimens determined by Kuznetzov as diakonoffi and labelled “N. Vietnam,"
                        - generic [ref=e663]: Chiengkhouan, 13.V.1986, V. Kuznerzov leg.”. The descriptions of the 2 genitalia of S. diakonoffi Kuzn. are given below in the Taxo-
                        - generic [ref=e664]: nomic appendix for the first time.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e665]: "Taxonomic notes: Characters of forewing pattern and coloration are very similar to those of Statherotis ?amaeboea (Lower, 1896) on the"
                        - generic [ref=e666]: "photograph in Horak, 2006: 192, fig. 394. However, she noted that the identity of this Australian species has generally been misconstrued"
                        - generic [ref=e667]: because it was based on the series of specimens from New Guinea determined by Meyrick and not on Lower’s type. Unfortunately the
                        - generic [ref=e668]: "single holotype ° of amaeboea lacks the abdomen and there is no additional material from the type locality (Horak, 2006: 193)."
                        - generic [ref=e669]: "Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Ban Chiéng Khoang."

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e714]: "Comments: In the original description Kuznetzov noted that the holotype has no cornuti in aedeagus (p. 808). During our study"
                        - generic [ref=e715]: we collected a series of specimens at the Mê Linh biological station (North Vietnam, Vinh Phuc Prov., Ngoc Thanh vill.) which
                        - generic [ref=e716]: "completely corresponded to the description and the figure by KuzNetzov (1997: Plate 2, fig. 12a), except for a strong bundle formed"

                        - generic [ref=e718]: the cornuti in the genitalia of the holotype were probably lost during preparation of the genitalia.
                      - paragraph:

                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."

                        - generic [ref=e630]: "Comments: The F of this species was described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988c: 96, fig. 36). Although Kuznetzov designa-"

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e633]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Grapholita but in 1992 it was transferred without any discussion to the"

                        - generic [ref=e635]: "work I follow the opinion by Kuznetzov and treat the species in Grapholita. Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Hanoi."

                        - generic [ref=e643]: original description KuzNETzov mentioned that the narrow valva of S. confinana Kuzn. differs from those of S. halantha MEYRICK,
                        - generic [ref=e644]: "1909 and_S. abrupta DiaKonorr, 1973 (KUZNETZOV, 2003: 729). The genitalia of the single specimen completely correspond with the"
                        - generic [ref=e645]: original description of S. confinana Kuzn. Thus, in spite of the specimen was marked by Kuznetzov as hapalantoides, it was consi-
                        - generic [ref=e646]: "dered to be a holotype of confinana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS, Semniotes confinana KUZNETZOV,"

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e605]: "from the collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KuzNetzov’s material 2 specimens were found: One of them bears KUZNETZov’s"
                        - generic [ref=e606]: handwritten red label “Holotypus, Peridaedala biuncana Kuzn.” and the second bears KuzNETzov’s handwritten white label “Peridae-
                        - generic [ref=e607]: "dala biuncana sp. n.”. The second specimen was considered as a paratype and marked with a red printed label by me: “PARATYPUS,"
                        - generic [ref=e608]: Peridaedala biuncana Kuznetzov, 1997”.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e609]: "Distribution: Vietnam, Tram Lap; Thailand; Indonesia (KUZNETZzov, 2000)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e610]: "18. blanditana Kuznetzov, 1988 (colour plate 7: 11)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e611]: "Griselda blanditana Kuznetzov, 1988, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 67 (3): 622, fig. 12."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e612]: "Griselda nielseni Kawase, 1989, Microlepidoptera of Thailand 2: 58, figs 90, 118. Locus typicus: Thailand, Chieng Mai Prov., Huai"
                        - generic [ref=e613]: Nam Dang.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e614]: "Types: Holotype, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 11.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratype: 1’, the same locality, 13.IV.1986,"
                        - generic [ref=e615]: V. Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e616]: "Present status: Rhopobota blanditana (KUZNETZzOV, 1988)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e617]: "Comments: The ? of this species is still unknown."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."
                        - generic [ref=e619]: (2005) who treated Griselda nielseni KAwaBE as a good species insertae sedis. Comparison of the original description of G nielseni
                        - generic [ref=e620]: Kawase and the holotype of G blanditana Kuzn. confirms that Griselda nielseni Kawase should be considered as a junior synonym
                        - generic [ref=e621]: of G blanditana Kuzn. Brown et al. (2005) placed G blanditana Kuzn. in the group “Eucosmini unplaced species” with a reference
                        - generic [ref=e622]: “Although described in Griselda (now considered a synonym of Epinotia), blanditana Kuzn. does not belong in Epinotia because it
                        - generic [ref=e623]: "lacks the cleft or divided uncus typical of the genus (R. BRown)” (BRown et al., 2005: 740). However, in 2000, KuzNnetzov transfer-"
                        - generic [ref=e624]: red blanditana to Rhopobota and this combination is accepted here.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e625]: "Distribution: Vietnam: Tam Dao; Thailand (KuzNetzov, 2000)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e626]: "19. comanticosta KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate 7: 16)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e627]: "Grapholita comanticosta KuzNEtTzov, 1988, Trudy zoologicheskogo Instituta, Leningrad, 176: 94, fig. 35."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e628]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 14.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 3 c7, 10 99, the same locality,"
                        - generic [ref=e629]: "9.-11.IV.1986, V. KuzNnetzov leg.; 2 #c*, 299, N. Vietnam, Hanoi, 2.-3.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e630]: "Comments: The F of this species was described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988c: 96, fig. 36). Although Kuznetzov designa-"
                        - generic [ref=e631]: ted 10 9¢ from Tam Dao as paratypes, only 6 of them were found in the collection of ZISP. Besides that, 2 gg, 2 99 were mentioned
                        - generic [ref=e632]: by Kuznetzov from Hanoi but actually 3 cc’, 1 2 of them are present in the collection.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e633]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Grapholita but in 1992 it was transferred without any discussion to the"
                        - generic [ref=e634]: genus Cydia by RAzowsx1. However, his opinion was ignored by later revisers (e.g. KUZzNETZov, 2000; BRowN et al., 2005). In this
                        - generic [ref=e635]: "work I follow the opinion by Kuznetzov and treat the species in Grapholita. Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Hanoi."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e636]: "20. confinana KuzneEtzov, 2003 (colour plate 7: 12)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e637]: "Semniotes confinana Kuznetzov, 2003, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 82 (3): 727, fig. 11."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e638]: "Types: Holotype g, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 26.X1.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e639]: "Comments: The 2 is still unknown. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KUZNETZov’s"
                        - generic [ref=e640]: material was one specimen collected 26.X1.1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten white label “He ab-
                        - generic [ref=e641]: "rupta u He hapalanta” [not abrupta and not hapalanta). On the other side of this label KUZNETZov wrote: “Semniotes hapalantoides"
                        - generic [ref=e642]: Kuzn. sp. n., holotype”. Probably “hapalanta” is the incorrect name of Semniotes halantha Meyrick, 1909. At the same time, in the
                        - generic [ref=e643]: original description KuzNETzov mentioned that the narrow valva of S. confinana Kuzn. differs from those of S. halantha MEYRICK,
                        - generic [ref=e644]: "1909 and_S. abrupta DiaKonorr, 1973 (KUZNETZOV, 2003: 729). The genitalia of the single specimen completely correspond with the"
                        - generic [ref=e645]: original description of S. confinana Kuzn. Thus, in spite of the specimen was marked by Kuznetzov as hapalantoides, it was consi-
                        - generic [ref=e646]: "dered to be a holotype of confinana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS, Semniotes confinana KUZNETZOV,"
                        - generic [ref=e647]: 2003”. The holotype has no hindwings and one of the forewings was glued to the thorax.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e648]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e649]: "21, dentiuncana KUzNEtzov, 2003 (colour plate 7: 2)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e650]: Drachmobola dentiuncana Kuznetzov, 2003, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 82 (3), 722, fig. 2.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e651]: "Types: Holotype g, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 1.XII.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e652]: "Comments: The 2 is not described. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP. However, in the drawer with"
                        - generic [ref=e653]: Kuznetzov’s working material was one specimen collected 1.XII. 1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten
                        - generic [ref=e654]: white label “Drachmobola sp. n.”. The genitalia of this specimen completely correspond with those figured in the original description
                        - generic [ref=e655]: "of dentiuncana. So it was considered to be a holotype of dentiuncana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS,"
                        - generic [ref=e656]: Drachmobola dentiuncana Kuznetzoy, 2003”. The holotype has no hindwings and one of the forewings was glued to the thorax.
                        - generic [ref=e657]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e658]: "22. diakonoffi KuzNetzov, 1988 (colour plate 7: 15)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e659]: "Statherotis diakonoffi KuzNETzov, 1988, Trudy vsesoyuznogo entomologicheskogo obshchestva 70: 168, fig. 3: 3."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e660]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 9.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratype: 1c, the same locality, 11.IV.1986,"
                        - generic [ref=e661]: V. Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e662]: "Comments: In the collection of ZISP there are also 2 9° specimens determined by Kuznetzov as diakonoffi and labelled “N. Vietnam,"
                        - generic [ref=e663]: Chiengkhouan, 13.V.1986, V. Kuznerzov leg.”. The descriptions of the 2 genitalia of S. diakonoffi Kuzn. are given below in the Taxo-
                        - generic [ref=e664]: nomic appendix for the first time.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e665]: "Taxonomic notes: Characters of forewing pattern and coloration are very similar to those of Statherotis ?amaeboea (Lower, 1896) on the"
                        - generic [ref=e666]: "photograph in Horak, 2006: 192, fig. 394. However, she noted that the identity of this Australian species has generally been misconstrued"
                        - generic [ref=e667]: because it was based on the series of specimens from New Guinea determined by Meyrick and not on Lower’s type. Unfortunately the
                        - generic [ref=e668]: "single holotype ° of amaeboea lacks the abdomen and there is no additional material from the type locality (Horak, 2006: 193)."
                        - generic [ref=e669]: "Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Ban Chiéng Khoang."

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e714]: "Comments: In the original description Kuznetzov noted that the holotype has no cornuti in aedeagus (p. 808). During our study"
                        - generic [ref=e715]: we collected a series of specimens at the Mê Linh biological station (North Vietnam, Vinh Phuc Prov., Ngoc Thanh vill.) which
                        - generic [ref=e716]: "completely corresponded to the description and the figure by KuzNetzov (1997: Plate 2, fig. 12a), except for a strong bundle formed"
                        - generic [ref=e717]: by long and slender cornuti in the vesica. Their length is approximately as the length of the aedeagus (Plate 2, fig. 12b). Therefore
                        - generic [ref=e718]: the cornuti in the genitalia of the holotype were probably lost during preparation of the genitalia.
                      - paragraph:

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."

                        - generic [ref=e630]: "Comments: The F of this species was described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988c: 96, fig. 36). Although Kuznetzov designa-"

                      - paragraph:

                        - generic [ref=e635]: "work I follow the opinion by Kuznetzov and treat the species in Grapholita. Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Hanoi."

                        - generic [ref=e643]: original description KuzNETzov mentioned that the narrow valva of S. confinana Kuzn. differs from those of S. halantha MEYRICK,
                        - generic [ref=e644]: "1909 and_S. abrupta DiaKonorr, 1973 (KUZNETZOV, 2003: 729). The genitalia of the single specimen completely correspond with the"

                        - generic [ref=e646]: "dered to be a holotype of confinana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS, Semniotes confinana KUZNETZOV,"

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e605]: "from the collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KuzNetzov’s material 2 specimens were found: One of them bears KUZNETZov’s"
                        - generic [ref=e606]: handwritten red label “Holotypus, Peridaedala biuncana Kuzn.” and the second bears KuzNETzov’s handwritten white label “Peridae-
                        - generic [ref=e607]: "dala biuncana sp. n.”. The second specimen was considered as a paratype and marked with a red printed label by me: “PARATYPUS,"
                        - generic [ref=e608]: Peridaedala biuncana Kuznetzov, 1997”.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e609]: "Distribution: Vietnam, Tram Lap; Thailand; Indonesia (KUZNETZzov, 2000)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e610]: "18. blanditana Kuznetzov, 1988 (colour plate 7: 11)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e611]: "Griselda blanditana Kuznetzov, 1988, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 67 (3): 622, fig. 12."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e612]: "Griselda nielseni Kawase, 1989, Microlepidoptera of Thailand 2: 58, figs 90, 118. Locus typicus: Thailand, Chieng Mai Prov., Huai"
                        - generic [ref=e613]: Nam Dang.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e614]: "Types: Holotype, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 11.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratype: 1’, the same locality, 13.IV.1986,"
                        - generic [ref=e615]: V. Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e616]: "Present status: Rhopobota blanditana (KUZNETZzOV, 1988)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e617]: "Comments: The ? of this species is still unknown."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e618]: "Taxonomic notes: Griselda nielseni KAWABE was synonymized by KuzNnetzov (2000), but this was not mentioned by Brown et al."
                        - generic [ref=e619]: (2005) who treated Griselda nielseni KAwaBE as a good species insertae sedis. Comparison of the original description of G nielseni
                        - generic [ref=e620]: Kawase and the holotype of G blanditana Kuzn. confirms that Griselda nielseni Kawase should be considered as a junior synonym
                        - generic [ref=e621]: of G blanditana Kuzn. Brown et al. (2005) placed G blanditana Kuzn. in the group “Eucosmini unplaced species” with a reference
                        - generic [ref=e622]: “Although described in Griselda (now considered a synonym of Epinotia), blanditana Kuzn. does not belong in Epinotia because it
                        - generic [ref=e623]: "lacks the cleft or divided uncus typical of the genus (R. BRown)” (BRown et al., 2005: 740). However, in 2000, KuzNnetzov transfer-"
                        - generic [ref=e624]: red blanditana to Rhopobota and this combination is accepted here.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e625]: "Distribution: Vietnam: Tam Dao; Thailand (KuzNetzov, 2000)."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e626]: "19. comanticosta KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate 7: 16)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e627]: "Grapholita comanticosta KuzNEtTzov, 1988, Trudy zoologicheskogo Instituta, Leningrad, 176: 94, fig. 35."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e628]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 14.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 3 c7, 10 99, the same locality,"
                        - generic [ref=e629]: "9.-11.IV.1986, V. KuzNnetzov leg.; 2 #c*, 299, N. Vietnam, Hanoi, 2.-3.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e630]: "Comments: The F of this species was described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988c: 96, fig. 36). Although Kuznetzov designa-"
                        - generic [ref=e631]: ted 10 9¢ from Tam Dao as paratypes, only 6 of them were found in the collection of ZISP. Besides that, 2 gg, 2 99 were mentioned
                        - generic [ref=e632]: by Kuznetzov from Hanoi but actually 3 cc’, 1 2 of them are present in the collection.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e633]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Grapholita but in 1992 it was transferred without any discussion to the"
                        - generic [ref=e634]: genus Cydia by RAzowsx1. However, his opinion was ignored by later revisers (e.g. KUZzNETZov, 2000; BRowN et al., 2005). In this
                        - generic [ref=e635]: "work I follow the opinion by Kuznetzov and treat the species in Grapholita. Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Hanoi."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e636]: "20. confinana KuzneEtzov, 2003 (colour plate 7: 12)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e637]: "Semniotes confinana Kuznetzov, 2003, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 82 (3): 727, fig. 11."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e638]: "Types: Holotype g, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 26.X1.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e639]: "Comments: The 2 is still unknown. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP, but in the drawer with KUZNETZov’s"
                        - generic [ref=e640]: material was one specimen collected 26.X1.1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten white label “He ab-
                        - generic [ref=e641]: "rupta u He hapalanta” [not abrupta and not hapalanta). On the other side of this label KUZNETZov wrote: “Semniotes hapalantoides"
                        - generic [ref=e642]: Kuzn. sp. n., holotype”. Probably “hapalanta” is the incorrect name of Semniotes halantha Meyrick, 1909. At the same time, in the
                        - generic [ref=e643]: original description KuzNETzov mentioned that the narrow valva of S. confinana Kuzn. differs from those of S. halantha MEYRICK,
                        - generic [ref=e644]: "1909 and_S. abrupta DiaKonorr, 1973 (KUZNETZOV, 2003: 729). The genitalia of the single specimen completely correspond with the"
                        - generic [ref=e645]: original description of S. confinana Kuzn. Thus, in spite of the specimen was marked by Kuznetzov as hapalantoides, it was consi-
                        - generic [ref=e646]: "dered to be a holotype of confinana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS, Semniotes confinana KUZNETZOV,"
                        - generic [ref=e647]: 2003”. The holotype has no hindwings and one of the forewings was glued to the thorax.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e648]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e649]: "21, dentiuncana KUzNEtzov, 2003 (colour plate 7: 2)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e650]: Drachmobola dentiuncana Kuznetzov, 2003, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 82 (3), 722, fig. 2.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e651]: "Types: Holotype g, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 1.XII.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e652]: "Comments: The 2 is not described. The holotype was not found in the main collection of ZISP. However, in the drawer with"
                        - generic [ref=e653]: Kuznetzov’s working material was one specimen collected 1.XII. 1988 in Tram Lap. This specimen bears KuzNetzov’s handwritten
                        - generic [ref=e654]: white label “Drachmobola sp. n.”. The genitalia of this specimen completely correspond with those figured in the original description
                        - generic [ref=e655]: "of dentiuncana. So it was considered to be a holotype of dentiuncana and marked by me with a red printed label: “HOLOTYPUS,"
                        - generic [ref=e656]: Drachmobola dentiuncana Kuznetzoy, 2003”. The holotype has no hindwings and one of the forewings was glued to the thorax.
                        - generic [ref=e657]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e658]: "22. diakonoffi KuzNetzov, 1988 (colour plate 7: 15)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e659]: "Statherotis diakonoffi KuzNETzov, 1988, Trudy vsesoyuznogo entomologicheskogo obshchestva 70: 168, fig. 3: 3."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e660]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 9.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratype: 1c, the same locality, 11.IV.1986,"
                        - generic [ref=e661]: V. Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e662]: "Comments: In the collection of ZISP there are also 2 9° specimens determined by Kuznetzov as diakonoffi and labelled “N. Vietnam,"
                        - generic [ref=e663]: Chiengkhouan, 13.V.1986, V. Kuznerzov leg.”. The descriptions of the 2 genitalia of S. diakonoffi Kuzn. are given below in the Taxo-
                        - generic [ref=e664]: nomic appendix for the first time.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e665]: "Taxonomic notes: Characters of forewing pattern and coloration are very similar to those of Statherotis ?amaeboea (Lower, 1896) on the"
                        - generic [ref=e666]: "photograph in Horak, 2006: 192, fig. 394. However, she noted that the identity of this Australian species has generally been misconstrued"
                        - generic [ref=e667]: because it was based on the series of specimens from New Guinea determined by Meyrick and not on Lower’s type. Unfortunately the
                        - generic [ref=e668]: "single holotype ° of amaeboea lacks the abdomen and there is no additional material from the type locality (Horak, 2006: 193)."
                        - generic [ref=e669]: "Distribution: North Vietnam: Tam Dao, Ban Chiéng Khoang."
                      - paragraph:

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e675]: "Types: Holotype 7, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 13.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e676]: "Comments: In the collection of ZISP two additional specimens (1 <, 1 2) were found. A ¢ was collected 10.IV.1986 in Tam Dao"
                        - generic [ref=e677]: and bears a red KuzNnetzov’s handwritten label “Metatypus Ricula dubitana Kuzn.” A ° was collected 11.IV.1986 at the same place.
                        - generic [ref=e678]: Kuznetzov identified it as Ricula ?)dubitana and noted on its label that the genitalia of this specimen were lost. Thus, ° genitalia of

                      - paragraph:

                      - paragraph:

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e682]: "Types: Holotype 9, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 9.XII.1988, V. KuzNETzov leg. - Paratype: 1 9, the"
                        - generic [ref=e683]: same locality, 14.XII.1988, V. KuzNetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e684]: "Comments: The & of this species was described in the same paper by KuzNetzov (1992a: 859, fig. 18). Metathorax with hindwings"

                        - generic [ref=e686]: "Distribution: Known only from the type locality."

                        - generic [ref=e687]: "25: figurana Kuznerzoy, 1997 (colour plate 8: 39)"

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e689]: "Types: Holotype ¢, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai-Kontum, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 28.X1.1988, V. KuzNErzov leg."
                        - generic [ref=e690]: "Comments: The 8 is still unknown. In the original description fig. 9 was erroneously named as Eucosmomorpha segregana sp. N.,"
                        - generic [ref=e691]: holotype, South Vietnam, Tramlap. Actually, this figure belongs to the holotype of E. figurana Kuzn.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e692]: "Taxonomic notes: In Brown et al. (2005) the original combination was given erroneously as Enarmonia figurana Kuzn. Distribu-"
                        - generic [ref=e693]: "tion: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e694]: "26. finitimana Kuznetzov, 1997 (colour plate 8: 37)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e695]: "Phaecasiophora finitimana KuzNEtzov, 1997, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 76 (4): 799, fig. 5."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e696]: "Types: Holotype , S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai-Kontum, Tramlap, 20 km N Buenluoi, 900 m, 30.21.1988, V. KuzNETzov leg."
                        - generic [ref=e697]: "Comments: The ? is unknown. Distribution: Known only from the type locality."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e698]: "27. flavescens KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate 8: 31)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e699]: "Tetramoera flavescens KUZNETzov, 1988, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie 67 (3): 619, fig. 7."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e700]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Sonla, Chiengchouan, 13.V.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 1c’, 4 99, the same province,"
                        - generic [ref=e701]: Naniu, 4.-12.V.1986, Kuznetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e702]: "Comments: The 2 of this species is described in the same paper by Kuznetzov (1988a: 620, fig. 8). Although KuzNetzov mentioned"
                        - generic [ref=e703]: "499 as paratypes, only 3 of them were found in the collection of ZISP. Distribution: North Vietnam: Ban Chiéng Khoang, Naniu."

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e706]: "Types: Holotype g, N. Vietnam, prov. Sonla, Chiengchouan, 13.V.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e707]: "Present status: Thaumatotibia fulturana (Kuznetzov, 1992). Comments: The ? is unknown."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e708]: "Taxonomic notes: The species was described in the genus Fulcrifera but KuzNetzov (1997) transferred it to Metriophlebia. Later"
                        - generic [ref=e709]: "Metriophlebia was synonymized with Thaumatotibia (e.g. BRown et al., 2005). Distribution: Vietnam: Ban Chiéng Khoang, Kan-"

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e711]: "29. fumidana Kuznetzov, 1997 (colour plate 8: 32)"
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e712]: "Dicnecidia fumidana Kuznerzov, 1997, Entomologicheskoe Obozrenie. 76 (4): 807, fig. 15."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e713]: "Types: Holotype ¢, S. Vietnam, prov. Gialai-Kontum, Kannak, 600 m, 11.21.1988, V. KuzNEtzov leg."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e714]: "Comments: In the original description Kuznetzov noted that the holotype has no cornuti in aedeagus (p. 808). During our study"
                        - generic [ref=e715]: we collected a series of specimens at the Mê Linh biological station (North Vietnam, Vinh Phuc Prov., Ngoc Thanh vill.) which
                        - generic [ref=e716]: "completely corresponded to the description and the figure by KuzNetzov (1997: Plate 2, fig. 12a), except for a strong bundle formed"
                        - generic [ref=e717]: by long and slender cornuti in the vesica. Their length is approximately as the length of the aedeagus (Plate 2, fig. 12b). Therefore
                        - generic [ref=e718]: the cornuti in the genitalia of the holotype were probably lost during preparation of the genitalia.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e719]: The original description was based on a single & specimen; the 2 is unknown. In the series of specimens from Mé Linh several 9°
                        - generic [ref=e720]: clearly correspond to the oo of D. fumidana Kuzn. They are therefore considered as 9 of this species. The description of the °
                        - generic [ref=e721]: "genitalia is given below in the taxonomic appendix. Distribution: North Vietnam, Kannack, Mé Linh biol. station."
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e722]: "30. ghilarovi KUZNETZOV, 1988 (colour plate’: 34)"

                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e724]: "Types: Holotype 7, N. Vietnam, prov. Vinhphu, Tamdao, 13.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg. - Paratypes: 11 gg, 11 99, the same locality,"
                        - generic [ref=e725]: 10.-13.1V.1986, 5 cc, 19, N. Vietnam, Hanoi, 3.IV.1986, V. KuzNetzov leg.
                      - paragraph:
                        - generic [ref=e726]: "Comments: The 2 of this species was described in the same paper by KuzNetzov (1988b: 180, fig. 9: 2). Although KuzNetzov noted"
                        - generic [ref=e727]: 11 cv, 11 9¢ from Tam Dao as paratypes, 16 c?, 13 99 with Kuznetzov’s handwritten red label “Paratype Sorolopha ghilarovi KuzN”
                        - generic [ref=e728]: were found in the collection of ZISP. All of them were collected in Tam Dao 10.-13.IV.1986. Besides that, only 4 paratype To from
                        - generic [ref=e729]: Hanoi were found in the collection. One other « and one ? from Hanoi mentioned as paratypes in the original description were
                        - generic [ref=e730]: "probably lost. Distribution: Vietnam, Fan-Si-Pan, Mai-Chau, Mt. NgocLinh (RazowskI, 2008), Hanoi, Tam Dao."
                      - paragraph:

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

> “67 species described by V. Kuznetzov from Vietnam are listed with short comments on the type series including descriptions of their labels. Colour images of the holotypes are given (col. pl. 7‑9). Descriptions of ♀♀ of five species are provided and their genitalia are figured.”

### Key passages from the text:

messages.content:
You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.

You are the WebSurfer agent. You retrieve information from the web by navigating and interacting with pages, exactly as a human would.

## Navigation policy
- Unless the user explicitly provides a URL or names a specific website to visit, always start at google.com. Open Google, type your search query, read the results, and follow links by clicking — do not jump directly to any URL, and do not construct or guess URLs from memory or training data.

## Page size management (critical)
Loading large, unfiltered pages makes it hard to locate relevant information and risks exceeding LLM context length limits. Before loading any page, actively try to reduce its size:
- Use the site's search box with specific keywords rather than browsing index pages.
- Apply any available filters: date range, category, author, language, file type, etc.
- Prefer paginated or scoped views over full listing pages.

## Tool selection
- Prefer specialized tools (ArXiv, Wikipedia, YouTube, direct download, etc.) when they directly match the task. Use browser automation only when no dedicated tool fits.
- Only Google Search is permitted as a search engine.
- For academic paper searches, prefer Google Scholar, arXiv, and DBLP.

## Output
- Produce well-structured, detailed output as required. Extract only what is relevant to the task.
- If you use browser tools to save any content, the browser will store it under the directory: [<PROJECT_ROOT>/tmp/browser_wp]. This is enforced by the browser itself — you only need to report the file path in your output when needed.

Work carefully, efficiently, and stay within your assigned retrieval scope.
